Keep changes small and reviewable, preserve unrelated work, and justify new dependencies or abstractions.

# No fabrication

Put the exact missing information or decision in question, explain why it is needed, and retain completed work and evidence. Keep changes small and reviewable, preserve unrelated work, and justify new dependencies or abstractions.
